workload.note: FusedMoE.select_experts (static) with enable_eplb=True on synthetic routing: 256 logical / 288 physical experts (32 replicated), top_k 8, M=64 and 1024; base = torch.rand replica pick + masks inline, gold = torch.compile'd eplb_map_to_physical_and_record.
